tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind panels and the grid.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, grid, sheet header, inputs. Ink text sits here.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: KPI tiles, row hover, secondary fills one step above surface.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Program group rows, segmented-control track, progress track.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and raised.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text such as instructor names and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, eyebrows, notes, table headers. 4.5:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and table rules.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Hover borders, dashed “nothing uploaded” outline, kbd keys.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: ADU maroon. Primary button, semester chip, sort arrow, focus ring, selected filter. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected KPI tile, “Ready to review” pill, current row highlight.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Border of accent-soft chips.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Meets the model course file: filled status dot, Approved pill, complete bars.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Complete pill.

tokens.name: part
tokens.usage: Partly there / in progress: outlined dot, progress bars, “due soon” chip.

tokens.name: part-soft
tokens.usage: Background of partial dots and In-progress pills.

tokens.name: miss
tokens.usage: Missing / overdue / needs revision. Never decorative.

tokens.name: miss-soft
tokens.usage: Background of missing dots and Needs-revision pills.

tokens.name: none
tokens.usage: “Not uploaded yet” dot glyph (decorative; 3:1).

tokens.name: none-soft
tokens.usage: Empty stack track, not-uploaded dot, Not-due pill.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The product name in the header.

styles.name: sheet-title
styles.usage: Course code at the top of the side sheet.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons and course codes in the grid.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Notes, cross-listed codes, due dates under the term.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kickers and table headers, in muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside pills and between dot glyphs.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a toolbar or filter bar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tile padding, KPI grid gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, page gutter, gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding and section gap.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Status dots, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, selects, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: KPI tiles, toolbar, due cards, checklist box.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Summary panels and the grid card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: State pills and the semester chip.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards: panels, toolbar, grid.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Side sheet and toast only.
